summary: Registering a Spotify app instantly yields client credentials for Development Mode, allowing immediate testing with up to 25 explicit users. However, moving to Extended Access for production requires passing a strict policy review and meeting high audience requirements.

difficulty.headline: Production access requires a formal quota extension review that takes 6+ weeks and requires meeting strict audience and platform alignment criteria.

factors.label: Strict Extended Access Criteria
factors.detail: Spotify reserves Extended Quota access for established, scalable applications, reportedly requiring an audience capable of sustaining 25,000 active monthly users.

evidence.quote: After that date, new proposals will need to meet the new criteria and Developer Terms, and the application submission process will move to our Web API page.

factors.label: Lengthy Review Wait Times
factors.detail: Quota extension reviews take at least 6 weeks, and any rejection resets the waiting period for another 6 weeks upon resubmission.

evidence.quote: During peak periods, it may take longer than six weeks.

factors.label: Broad Prohibited Use Cases
factors.detail: Spotify prohibits AI voice assistants, games/trivia, audio analysis, and commercial in-store playback.

evidence.quote: Do not create a voice-enabled SDA that enables a user to control Spotify with their voice, or any kind of voice assistant that provides voice-control functionality.

can_test_before_approval.detail: Apps are created immediately in Development Mode, giving developers instant access to Client IDs and Client Secrets to build and test OAuth flows with up to 25 whitelisted user accounts.

requirements.label: Spotify Account
requirements.detail: A registered Spotify account is required to access the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

requirements.label: Public Privacy Policy
requirements.detail: Developers must provide a privacy policy detailing how user data is collected, processed, and disclosed.

evidence.quote: You must provide a privacy policy which clearly describes how you intend to access, use, process and disclose user data.

requirements.label: User Disconnect and Data Deletion Mechanism
requirements.detail: The application must allow users to disconnect their Spotify account and must delete user data upon request.

evidence.quote: Don’t mislead or confuse users about the ways you intend to use their data.

requirements.label: Compliance with Prohibited Uses
requirements.detail: Apps must not include trivia games, voice assistants controlling playback, or content analysis/listenership metrics.

evidence.quote: Do not create a game, including trivia quizzes.

steps.title: Review Policy and Prohibited Use Cases
steps.detail: Verify that your AI application does not fall under prohibited categories such as voice assistants, games, content analytics, or data transfer to non-playlist services.
steps.agent_assist: Audit proposed product architecture against Spotify Developer Policy restrictions, identifying any prohibited voice assistant, trivia, or audio analysis features.

evidence.quote: Do not create a voice-enabled SDA that enables a user to control Spotify with their voice, or any kind of voice assistant that provides voice-control functionality.

steps.title: Create Developer App and Retrieve Credentials
steps.detail: Log into the Spotify Developer Dashboard, create a new app entry, and accept the Developer Terms to obtain your Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.agent_assist: Draft the app title, short description, and configuration options required during initial app creation.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Test Users
steps.detail: Save target OAuth redirect URIs in the dashboard settings and add up to 25 Spotify account emails to the Development Mode user whitelist.
steps.agent_assist: Generate standard valid redirect URI formats for your application environments and list required test user account formats.

steps.title: Draft Privacy Policy and Disconnect Flow
steps.detail: Publish a privacy policy URL and build an account disconnection feature allowing users to revoke access and delete stored data.
steps.agent_assist: Draft privacy policy copy detailing Spotify data handling and write technical specs for a user account disconnect and data deletion endpoint.

evidence.quote: You must provide a privacy policy which clearly describes how you intend to access, use, process and disclose user data.

steps.title: Prepare Extended Access Submission
steps.detail: Assemble required materials for production quota review, including scope justifications, audience scalability proof, architecture details, and UI screenshots.
steps.agent_assist: Draft complete responses for extended quota submission fields, justifying each scope and documenting audience size and compliance details.

evidence.quote: over 95% of the applications we receive for extended Web API access fall short of basic security, privacy, and licensing standards.

steps.title: Submit Quota Extension Request
steps.detail: Fill out and submit the official Extended Access application form via the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

steps.title: Wait for Spotify Review
steps.detail: Wait for the Spotify Developer team to review the submission. Review times typically take at least six weeks.

evidence.quote: During peak periods, it may take longer than six weeks.

steps.title: Respond to Review Decision
steps.detail: If approved, your app moves to Extended Quota mode. If rejected, review the decision email, apply fixes, and resubmit (restarting the 6-week SLA).
steps.agent_assist: Analyze rejection feedback or audit non-compliance issues to draft a revised application submission.

evidence.quote: If your request is rejected and needs to be resubmitted, an SLA of another 6 weeks will be applied after resubmission.

gotchas.title: Rejection Resets Review SLA by 6 Weeks
gotchas.detail: If an extended access request is rejected, resubmitting starts a brand-new 6-week review waiting window.

evidence.quote: If your request is rejected and needs to be resubmitted, an SLA of another 6 weeks will be applied after resubmission.

gotchas.title: High Rejection Rate for Extended Access
gotchas.detail: Over 95% of quota extension applications fail due to privacy, security, or licensing non-compliance.

evidence.quote: over 95% of the applications we receive for extended Web API access fall short of basic security, privacy, and licensing standards.

gotchas.title: Prohibited AI and Voice Control Use Cases
gotchas.detail: Creating voice assistants to control Spotify playback or analyzing audio/listenership metrics strictly violates policy.

evidence.quote: Do not create a voice-enabled SDA that enables a user to control Spotify with their voice, or any kind of voice assistant that provides voice-control functionality.

blockers.problem: Application building prohibited functionality (e.g. voice agent, games, metrics analysis).
blockers.why: Spotify Developer Policy strictly prohibits voice-control assistants, trivia games, and listenership benchmarking/analysis.
blockers.fix: Remove non-compliant features from the product design prior to submitting for Extended Access.

evidence.quote: Do not create a game, including trivia quizzes.

blockers.problem: Application rejected without explicit explanation email.
blockers.why: High submission volumes can cause brief responses or missing automated rejection emails.
blockers.fix: Thoroughly review Developer Terms, Developer Policy, and Design Guidelines independently, fix potential violations, and resubmit.

evidence.quote: If a submission was rejected, there must be a reason for it, so we suggest tweaking your app or your application to comply with the requirements.

blockers.problem: App locked to 25 users in Development Mode during production launch.
blockers.why: Development Mode restricts access strictly to 25 manually whitelisted Spotify accounts.
blockers.fix: Apply for Extended Access well in advance of public launch to accommodate the 6+ week review timeline.

uncertain: The official exact SLA duration for initial Extended Access applications beyond the general 6+ week community estimate.
Whether early-stage startups without an existing 25,000 monthly active user base can qualify for Extended Quota Access.
